name: Feegly the Exiled
summary: Feegly the Exiled is an outcast dwarf found lurking near the dwarven excavation at Bael Modan in the southern Barrens. Once praised as one of the expedition's finest diggers, his obsession with an uncovered relic led General Twinbraid to drive him off.

sections.title: A Digger's Ruin
sections.body: Before his exile, Feegly was regarded as one of the premier excavators within Bael Modan. The Tear of the Moons was the first great discovery made at the dig, and Feegly claimed its power as his own. General Twinbraid called the gem cursed, locked it away in Bael'dun Keep and drove Feegly off. He now broods alone, desperate to reclaim the very gem that dooms him: when he finally holds it again, the Tear shatters and he twists into a hideous, hunched trogg.

faq.q: Why does Feegly look like a trogg?
faq.answer: Feegly is a dwarf, an exiled excavator from the Bael Modan dig who covets a relic known as the Tear of the Moons.

faq.q: Why was Feegly exiled from Bael Modan?
faq.answer: Feegly grew obsessed with the Tear of the Moons, the first great discovery at Bael Modan. General Twinbraid called the gem cursed, locked it away in Bael'dun Keep and drove Feegly off.

faq.q: Why is Feegly willing to talk to Horde adventurers?
aliases: why is feegly friendly to horde
faq.answer: Betrayed and cast out by his fellow dwarves, Feegly holds no loyalty toward the Alliance expedition. He is desperate enough to seek aid from Horde travelers to retrieve the relic he covets.

faq.q: What is the Tear of the Moons?
faq.answer: The Tear of the Moons is a gem the excavators uncovered at Bael Modan, their first great discovery there. Feegly claims it gave him power, but General Twinbraid deemed it cursed and locked it away in Bael'dun Keep.

angles.text: For dwarves, Feegly is a tragic and terrifying warning: an accomplished digger whose obsession with an unearthed relic cost him his place among his kin.
Feegly's bitter grudge against the Bael Modan excavators makes him an unexpected ally for Horde wanderers seeking to sabotage the dwarven expedition in the Barrens.
